movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.overview: Follows a hapless courier tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital. He soon finds himself caught in the middle of an outbreak and must fight through hordes of mutated creatures to survive.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.overview: Based on the true story of the uprising that inspired the legend of Robin Hood, Andrew Garfield stars as the leader of a rebellion against the tyranny of King Richard II in a fight for justice.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.overview: A multi generational family of witches, cursed to be loveless for centuries, attempts to break the spell by confronting dark secrets and sacrificing for each other.

movies.title: Runner
movies.overview: A former soldier and his unlikely partner become the targets of a ruthless cartel while racing to complete a critical medical delivery and save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.overview: After her mysterious kidnapping in NYC, Spanish tycoon's daughter Marfil Cortés gets bodyguard Sebastián Moore. Despite clashing personalities, attraction grows as they face escalating threats in Spain, where appearances deceive.

shows.title: Mousetrap
shows.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

shows.title: Lanterns
shows.overview: Lanterns follows new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, two intergalactic cops drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

shows.title: My Brilliant Career
shows.overview: In 1900 Australia, a headstrong farm girl dreams of writing while society and family expectations clash with her fierce desire for independence and creative freedom.

shows.title: Our Sticky Love
shows.overview: A former boxing champion turned gang member seeks redemption as a small-town boxing coach, while becoming entangled with an amnesiac prosecutor and a complex web of lies surrounding their shared past.

shows.title: The Shards
shows.overview: The Shards is part teenage coming of age, erotic thriller and exploration of the untamed and mysterious era of Los Angeles 1981, tracking a group of privileged high school friends as a serial killer strikes across the city.

anime.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life
anime.overview: Once the Demon King, now a shut-in NEET—Ryuusei Narukami’s second life is anything but peaceful! When Meteor Hanaori, the Hero who once defeated him, suddenly returns as a normal high school girl, his world is thrown into chaos.…
